hazard: Lack of action on high clozapine blood test results
theme: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

reports.title: Ian Allen
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

promises.quote: the MHRA communicated advice on monitoring blood concentrations of clozapine and other antipsychotics in the August 2020 edition of Drug Safety Update', which is the MHRA's monthly newsletter for healthcare professionals about medicines safety.
promises.summary: MHRA issued August 2020 guidance on clozapine blood level monitoring for toxicity

concerns.quote: In February 2019 a blood test result confirmed that Mr Allen had a high level of clozapine in his blood. This was not acted upon and no further blood test was taken. The clozapine dose was not adjusted as it should have been.
concerns.hazard: lack of action on high clozapine blood test results

reports.title: Mohammed Hussain: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: We will continue to keep the issue of monitoring for clozapine toxicity under close review, including reviewing Yellow Card cases and we will be writing to the marketing authorisation holders to investigate further thresholds for clozapine toxicity.
promises.summary: Continue monitoring clozapine toxicity and write to marketing authorisation holders to investigate thresholds

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of a reliable system to ensure that elevated clozapine blood test results are recognised and acted upon. The earlier report focuses on escalation of results to consultants, while the later report stresses the need for highlighting high results in clinical notes.
links.earlier_quote: In February 2019 a blood test result confirmed that Mr Allen had a high level of clozapine in his blood. This was not acted upon and no further blood test was taken. The clozapine dose was not adjusted as it should have been.
links.later_quote: There was no system for highlighting high clozapine results in the rio notes which are routinely used by all clinicians.
links.promise_quote: There is a system in place whereby anomalous results received are escalated to the Consultant, for example, via the Multi-Disciplinary Team meeting, the administrative staff in receipt of paper results or by junior medical staff who have checked electronic investigations; however on this occasion it appears that this failed.
